title: How we work with local people
intro: Local people are partners in shaping our work, sharing their expertise and helping create change.

blocks.heading: Work together
paragraphs: We listen to people affected by poverty and injustice and work alongside them to understand priorities and improve services.

blocks.heading: Share power and influence
paragraphs: We support people to build skills, take action and make their voices heard in decisions that affect their lives.

blocks.heading: Build partnerships
paragraphs: We collaborate with community organisations, public services, researchers and others to make lasting change.
